# packages and data

```{r}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
data_path <- here("stroop_flanker_raw.csv")
data <- read.csv(data_path)
```

# separate by task, clean

## stroop data

```{r}
stroop <- data |> 
  filter(task=="stroop_response") |> 
  select(subj_code,color,text,response,correct_response,correct,rt,trial_index) |> 
  mutate(congruent = ifelse(color==text,1,0))
```

correct responses for congruent vs. incongruent trials

```{r}
stroop |> 
  mutate(correct=factor(ifelse(correct=="true",1,0))) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x=factor(congruent),y=1,fill=correct))+
  geom_bar(position="fill", stat="identity")+
  theme_minimal()+
  labs(x="\ncongruent",y="prop correct\n",subtitle="stroop task, proportion correct for congruent vs. incongruent")
```
